run_nevergrad_optimization: run nevergrad gradient-free optimization on a CompilerEnv to find the best sequence of compiler actions
run_nevergrad_with_runtime_target: run nevergrad optimization targeting runtime performance on a CompilerEnv with a specified search time budget
run_nevergrad_with_cached_rewards: run nevergrad optimization with LRU-cached deterministic rewards for non-runtime optimization targets
run_nevergrad_custom_optimizer: run nevergrad optimization using a custom optimizer like DiscreteLenglerOnePlusOne with a specified episode length
run_nevergrad_replay_best: run nevergrad optimization and replay the best recommended action sequence on the environment
